description: S459 LOW-4 + MED-1 legitimate twin of shared-collection-delta-reject-rt: every write here satisfies every position that holds what it changes, so each is applied. (1) `@x = @y` then `@x = [8]` releases the alias, so @x's tighter type (`number(>5)[]`) no longer constrains @y's array and `@y.push(3)` is admitted. (2) copy-on-write field / row writes with valid values, and a write of an unrefined field. (3) a push both positions of one struct value admit. (4) a valid push into a nested array.
rationale: §53.3.3: "The assignment is applied if and only if the predicate evaluates to true." A released alias is no longer a binding site of the released cell's type.
